---
title: "AGFR tutorials"
---

Step-by-step tutorials with the AGFR graphical interface.

**Before you start:**

- [Install ADFRsuite 1.0](download.qmd), which includes AGFR.
- Download and unzip the
  [tutorial data](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/download/1063/)
  (`ADFRsuite-1.0_tutorial_data.zip`).
- Start the graphical interface with `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin/agfrgui`.

For command-line examples see the [AutoDockFR tutorials](/software/adfr/tutorials.qmd).
